description: Search the US Federal Register, the government's daily journal of rules, proposed rules, notices and presidential documents. Filter by keyword, type, agency and date range, only items still open for comment, or look up one document by number. Returns title, agency, publication and effective dates, comment deadline, a trimmed abstract, citation, docket IDs and official links. Useful for agents that monitor regulation. Not charged for invalid input or when nothing matches. Paid via x402; see list_prices.

commentsOpen.description: Optional: only items whose public comment period is still open.

documentNumber.description: Optional: look up one document by its Federal Register number instead of searching.

query.description: Optional keyword or phrase, e.g. "lead pipes".

since.description: Optional: published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

type.description: Optional: rule, proposed_rule, notice or presidential.

until.description: Optional: published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: federal_register_search
title: US Federal Register search: new rules, proposed rules and notices by topic, agency and date, with comment deadlines
